hero.titleHtml: Chapter 1: Circular and Rotational Motion Circular & Rotational Motion
hero.lead: From a car's spinning wheels to satellites orbiting the Earth: in this chapter we study circular and rotational motion, centripetal force, Kepler's laws, moment of inertia, and angular momentum.

objectivesLead: After completing this chapter, the student will be able to:
objectives: Know circular and rotational motion, and centripetal force.
Know power, work, and rotational motion.

Grasp the following concepts and derive their values using mathematical equations: rotational motion, angular velocity, angular acceleration, moment of inertia, and power and work in rotational motion.
Know Kepler's laws of circular motion, with satellite motion as an example.
